prompt: The man in the reference image remains seated and quietly listens to the unseen person to camera-right. During this three-second shot he blinks once naturally and breathes gently, keeping his mouth closed. Locked camera, one continuous shot, no cuts. Preserve the face, hair, stubble, jacket, table and lighting from the reference image. Nobody else enters the frame; no hands near his face. No speech or music; subtle quiet room ambience only if audio is generated.

modelSpec.description: Consistently excellent results, with even better value. First choice for single-image to video generation. For multi-image to video generation, use kling3.0-omni instead.

arguments.name: prompt
arguments.description: Text prompt describing the desired motion / scene. The input image is the primary driver. Required; empty string is allowed for pure image animation.

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: Video duration in seconds, support 3s to 15s.

arguments.name: imageCount
arguments.description: Number of videos to generate per request, max to 4.

inputs.name: first_image
inputs.description: Source image URL used as the first frame to animate. (Must be url returned by file_upload tool, or a publicly accessible external file URL. No local file path.)

items.msg: slot first_image: URL externa (não verifiquei o conteúdo; URLs podem expirar; prazo não verificado).
Use somente os campos declarados neste snapshot; ausência de controle de áudio não garante silêncio.
